messages.author: fd4b1f1fe420bf96
messages.subject: Re: Human exon array, Exception: The specified CDF structure is not  compatible with the chip type of the CEL file.
parts:
I think I solved it.
When I performed the analysis first time I used HuEx-1_0-st-
v2,main,A20071112,EP.cdf and then I tried with the HuEx-1_0-st-
v2,coreR3,A20071112,EP and force=FALSE.
So I have to use force=TRUE in the summarization step to overwrite the
CEL files or to use tags to define the plm folder, as is recommended
in the discussion cited in Human exon array analysis

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/browse_thread/thread/86e48eff1e7bd457/c892034d3061d32f?lnk=gst&q=miRNA#c892034d3061d32f

thank you!
